title: Kissed Dense Tunisian Narutomaki Tagine
description: Rich and intense, this Tunisian tagine is a perfect date-night dish, featuring the sweetness of narutomaki and the tang of nuka-pickled vegetables. Diabetic-friendly and packed with protein, this meal is sure to delight.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a neutral-tasting oil for this dish

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the ground cumin and sweet paprika, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the nuka-pickled vegetables, narutomaki, and chicken broth, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the diabetic-friendly honey and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sauce has reduced slightly.
Season the tagine with salt and black pepper to taste, and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the Kissed Dense Tunisian Narutomaki Tagine over rice or couscous, and enjoy!
